title: Carbon engineering for sodium batteries: multi-role architectures bridging material design and hybrid system innovation
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS00515A, Review Article
Qianxiong Wen, Chuangchuang Li, Qinghang Chen, Pandeng Zhao, Chun Wu, Xingqiao Wu, Shu-Lei Chou
Intrinsic and extrinsic factors of carbon determine Na storage. This review compares their roles across four Na battery systems, establishes a structure–performance–function framework, and proposes a hybrid Na battery design.
